description: Use this when the user asks for one stock's ValuEdge fair value, current price, margin of safety, valuation method, assumptions, confidence, or valuation risk. official_fair_value_source identifies the upstream model/component, while valuation_method_label describes headline composition, so a DCF source can accompany a blended headline. specialist_model.fair_value_blend is the optional source-provided equity-model breakdown and may be null when unavailable; blending_applied is independently reconciled from valid top-level canonical DCF/multiples values and weights. Do not use it for a user's private portfolio.
name: get_stock_valuation
title: Get stock valuation
